words: The 0.3.1 series contract adds an optional series field income_claim, fixed at absent with the reason SOURCE_REPORTS_NO_INCOME and present exactly when every income entry is null, and a top-level income_claim_rule that states the same rule in words. It marks unreported_trading_days_basis const with a one-line rule-24 note, adds the optional manifest field calendar_source with the values pandas_market_calendars and fallback_2010_2027, and appends the 0.3.0 bytes to the lineage. The 0.3.0 predecessor test was changed on six lines to follow the new declarations. Every series and manifest written without the new keys still validates, and the synthetic validator in the new test file accepts seven documents and rejects eight. NOT PROVEN: that any publisher writes income_claim or calendar_source, and that the Performance page mirror reads them; both belong to later cells, the reader cell being 2.0.0_SA_COO~C2. The source column the claim cites is not yet in the source contract file at this base, which is recorded as a surprise row.
